cards.mood: The piece opens with a suspended, meditative stillness established by wordless vocal textures, creating an atmosphere of vast isolation.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Wrapped in the velvet of silent space
Dust of stars on a frozen face
Ancient stones hold the weight of time
Moving in a slow and steady climb
[Chorus]
Floating where the shadows softly bloom
Dancing in the hollow of the moon
Echoes of light in a velvet sea
Searching for what was meant to be
[Verse]
Silver mist hangs in the heavy air
A lonely path that leads nowhere
The ghost of a memory starts to fade
In the garden that the starlight made
[Chorus]
Floating where the shadows softly bloom
Dancing in the hollow of the moon
Echoes of light in a velvet sea
Searching for what was meant to be
[Bridge]
Gravity pulls with a gentle hand
Sinking deep into the shifting sand
[Chorus]
Floating where the shadows softly bloom
Dancing in the hollow of the moon
Echoes of light in a velvet sea
Searching for what was meant to be
[Outro]
